messages:
sam: FYI incoming escalation from Acme — p99 for the tool-call path jumped to ~1.8s since ~03:00 UTC, customers hitting timeouts

maria: ack. any recent deploys touching the schema/validator stack?

sam: yes, redeploy at 02:55 rolled validator v2.1 which added deeper JSON schema enforcement for structured outputs

jamal: digging into traces now — seeing a lot more time in schema validation step. p99 went from ~120ms -> ~650ms on the validator stage

jamal: sample trace snippet:
jamal: ```
# trace snippet
req_id=acme-42
tool-router.queue_length=11
schema.validate_ms=540
schema.compile_ms=210
kv_cache.hit=false
runtime.exec_ms=82
total_ms=1613
```

infra-bot: alert: autoscale event — dedicated-pool-7 scaled up at 03:07 UTC (trigger: queue_length>10)

elaine: repro steps from support (copied):
elaine: 1) POST /v1/call with toolchain payload (~1.2KB JSON body)
elaine: 2) include function definitions with nested output schema (~6 nested levels)
elaine: 3) run 8 concurrent requests from single client -> observe p95 ~420ms, p99 ~1.4-1.9s

maria: hypothesis: v2.1's deep-validation path compiles schemas synchronously on first use and doesn't cache compiled AST aggressively. under burst, compile + validate causes threads to block and triggers GC pressure

jamal: quick checks: validator threadpool utilization at peak = 98%, small heaps showing frequent STW pauses correlated with spikes

jamal: mitigation ideas: 1) enable compiled-schema cache per model 2) fast-path shallow validation for tool-router traffic 3) increase validator pool temporarily 4) offload heavy validation to background/async job

oncall-sre: applied canary change at 03:18 UTC: redwood.experimental.schema_cache=true on 10% canary (config key) and bumped validator pool 8->16 on canary nodes

oncall-sre: config snippet applied:
oncall-sre: ```json
{
  "schema_cache.enabled": true,
  "validator.thread_pool_size": 16,
  "router.validation_mode": "fast-path-for-toolcall"
}
```

maria: after canary metrics (03:18-03:30): p95 (tool-call path) improved 420ms -> 180ms, p99 1.8s -> ~720ms. queue_length dropped to median 2

sam: customer updated. we're holding while canary ramps. ETA to 100% rollout once we validate two more 1h windows without regression

jamal: follow-ups for engineering backlog:
jamal: - add validator.compile_count and compile_ms metrics per model
jamal: - add schema cache hit/miss telemetry
jamal: - make deep validation opt-in for heavyweight schemas (opt-out in tool-router)
jamal: - add a safety circuit: if validator latency > 300ms then fallback to fast-path

elaine: ticket updated with repro steps + temp mitigations + canary links. support routed to customer success to confirm reduced incidence :thumbsup:

sam: big thanks to oncall and infra. marking triage done; moving to eng-runtime and eng-ml for prioritized fixes

maria: note: also look at interactions with KV cache — a lot of these traces were cold cache. compiled-schema cache should persist across requests and reduce churn

oncall-sre: closing the escalation channel for now. will reopen if p99 climbs above 1s again. :white_check_mark:
